meta.coverage_note: Two sources, kept apart on purpose. Vacancy counts are live openings registered at the Czech Labour Office (Úřad práce ČR) — real postings, though the register skews toward service, trades and operational roles, so higher-skill and senior corporate counts read low. Every salary figure comes instead from the official ISPV earnings survey (and its regional RSCP cut): what people are actually paid, not what a posting advertises. Where the survey has no figure for something, we leave it out rather than estimate it.
